name: Battlefield 6
title: Battlefield 6 Gameplay Trailer
FirstLine: Worked on latest Battlefield game as a UI Software Engineer Intern.
Bulletpoints: Frostbite Engine, proprietary engine tech with WYSIWYG widget editor
C++ to build data binding relationships between UI widgets and code and Scripted UI elements with propriety visual scripting language in engine
Implemented telemetry events for gathering analytics from live game.
Agile workflow, cross-studio collaboration and hybrid work.
Used Perforce source control, and Swarm for code reviews.

name: Bop It with Playstation 5 SDKs
title: PS5 Bop It
FirstLine: Recreation of a 'Bop It' style game.
Bulletpoints: Sole Programmer - Created a Bop It Style game as part of a University project.
Uses a state machine to transition between the different input states, had to explore more traditional procedural programming, as well as the usual OOP and event driven paradigms.
This is also compatible with the PlayStation Access controller
Also had a chance to briefly explore profiling in this project

name: Clocking Out
title: ClockingOut
FirstLine: Created for the Brackeys Game Jam 2025.1 - “Nothing can go wrong
Bulletpoints: An eerie puzzle game, where you spend the last hours of your workday closing up the petrol station you work at, per the instructions your boss left behind for you. As long as you do as you're told, nothing can go wrong.
Worked as a programmer - focused on Audio, the puzzles and the dialogue feature, as well as bug fixing

name: All dogs go to heaven
title: Gameplay Programming
FirstLine: A vertical slice of a game concept around the prompt 'All Dogs go to Heaven'
Bulletpoints: Sole Programmer
The player is assigned a random list of tasks that they have to get their human to solve - they do this by pulling and pushing objects, as well as barking to get their human's attention.
Uses state machines, observers and nav meshes.

name: Anxiety Antics
title: Anxiety Antics Gameplay
FirstLine: Created for “Safe in our World” Game Jam (2024), used as a way to experiement with Godot
Bulletpoints: Solo Project - Programmer, artist (incl animations)
Messaging game: Use of a Drag and drop mechanic, input validation where the draggable  objects would randomly generate after a timer ran out.
Hit thoughts: Procedurally generate thoughts objects, which would be hit away after user input.
Appointment: Inputting generated combinations and validating the users inputs as well as a Rhythm inspired game.
Driving: A frogger style mini game.
Spiral/Whirlpool: The player sprite is being pulled into the centre of the whirlpool and the user attempts to swim out.
Shop: Has a depth-first search algorithm to generate the maze each time, with the addition of collectables and the use of Godot’s lighting system, as well as Eyes that follow the player.
Waitressing: E to interact, Tables transfer through different states (empty, occupied, eating, dirty). The customers are able to select empty tables, if they wait too long they will become angry.

name: Potion Profiteer
title: Potion Profiteer Gameplay
Bulletpoints: Acting producer, volunteered to keep tabs of the team's well being and progress to ensure targets were being met, and if issues occurred, delegating to other members or taking the workload on myself. A Trello board was used to support this.

Created the foundations of the game's framework - a central node, which was the main data handler, managed our inventory system (using a dictionary) and allowed for easy interaction between other programmers’ work.
Created the gameplay elements within the shop, all of which were linked with the aforementioned inventory system.
Worked with fellow programmers to ensure branches could merge safely on github.

name: Stand up Simulator
title: Stand-Up Sim Gameplay
FirstLine: Created for the Global Game Jam 2024 - “Make me laugh”
Bulletpoints: I worked mostly on Game Logic; file handling (CSV files) to store game data and creating the base mechanics of the game, i.e. the scoring system.
I also created the drag and drop features for the game, as I felt that it would help create a better user experience.

name: Shed card game
title: Shed Project (UE5)
FirstLine: Recreation of the card game “Shed” in UE5.
Bulletpoints: Sole Programmer
Cards: Game object which stores the suit and the card value, is able to be instantiated to create a whole deck of cards
Game participant: Has different ideas to indicate the user and the computer player, stores the players’ cards.
Main Game: Has all of the functions for the game to run properly, including the functions to allow the computer to select a card based on what would be the best choice.
UE5 Widgets System: Dynamically changed during runtime to display the cards as buttons, some of which are only accessible after a certain point of the game.

name: Space Platformer
title: Space Platformer Gameplay
Bulletpoints: Took on a leadership role, making sure all essential work was completed.
Lead Programmer, Gameplay Mechanics,animation states,procedurally generating platforms, power ups - everything except the menu mechanics.

name: NEA
title: NEA Computer Science Demo
FirstLine: A learning program - inspired by quizlet, created as part of an AQA A-level NEA.
Bulletpoints: Sole Programmer
Database handling in SQLite: multiple, connected tables that interact with each other
Account system - this utilises the database system
Pairs Game: created a question and answer object from a selected question bank, the user can drag the questions or answers to the other
Word scramble: Using a recursive algorithm, a country name would get scrambled, hints were also available.
Quiz: Simple question and answer
Question Banks: Users are able to create their own question banks - only they could read/write to their own banks.
Maps: If the database is empty, it is populated from a .txt file.
User Stats: A merge sort lists the top highscores of each, and calculates the average score for each game and the percentile to compare their highest score to other users.
